standard.summary: 训练加载时把 Anima DiT 交错复制相邻层扩到更多层数，新层的输出投影归零（恒等残差），得到一个更深的可训练底座。仅支持 Anima 全参微调。
standard.effect: 模型按 anima_depth_expansion_target_layers 重建为更深结构（如 28 层 → 40 层），初始行为与原模型一致（新层零初始化输出）；训练范围由 anima_depth_expansion_train_scope 控制；保存的产物是完整扩层底座。
standard.whenToUse: 想以较低成本扩大模型容量（Depth Up-Scaling 路线）、在原模型能力基础上继续拉伸上限时；准备做扩层后长期微调的项目。
standard.avoidWhen: LoRA 训练不支持；显存按扩层后的层数计费，16GB 级显卡谨慎评估；从扩层 checkpoint 恢复训练时必须保持相同的扩层配置（层数不匹配后端会明确报错）。

standard_en.summary: At load time it interleaves copies of neighbouring Anima DiT layers up to a larger layer count, zeroing the new layers' output projections (identity residual), which yields a deeper trainable base. Anima full-parameter finetuning only.
standard_en.effect: The model is rebuilt to the deeper structure given by anima_depth_expansion_target_layers -- 28 layers to 40, say -- and behaves identically to the original at the start because the new layers' outputs are zero-initialised. What trains is controlled by anima_depth_expansion_train_scope, and the saved artefact is the complete expanded base.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want to grow model capacity cheaply (the Depth Up-Scaling route) and push the ceiling further on top of the original model's ability; a project that plans to finetune the expanded base long-term.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not supported for LoRA training. VRAM is billed at the expanded layer count, so evaluate carefully on a 16GB-class card. Resuming from an expanded checkpoint requires the same expansion configuration -- the backend reports an explicit error on a layer-count mismatch.

advanced.principle: Depth Up-Scaling（如 SOLAR 的做法）：交错复制已有 transformer 层构造更深网络，把新层的输出投影零初始化使残差路径退化为恒等，保证扩层瞬间模型输出不变，训练从「无损起点」开始学习新增容量。
advanced.intervention: config_adapter_conversion_context.py：归一化 enabled/target_layers/train_scope（scope 非法且 enabled 时直接抛错）；anima_depth_expansion_runtime.py：加载时执行交错复制与零投影；anima_full_finetune.py：resume 时校验 checkpoint 层数与配置一致，不一致给出修复指引。
advanced.expectedImpact: 参数量与显存按层数比例上升；扩层容量需要足够数据与步数才能兑现为质量收益。
advanced.tradeoffs: 产物是完整底座（体积大，非 LoRA）；扩层模型的推理成本永久上升；训练范围选 all 时成本最高、选 new_layers 最接近标准 DUS 配方。

advanced_en.principle: Depth Up-Scaling (as in SOLAR): interleaves and duplicates existing transformer layers to build a deeper network, zero-initializing the new layers' output projections so the residual path degrades to identity — the model's output is unchanged at the instant of expansion, and training learns the new capacity from a lossless starting point.
advanced_en.intervention: config_adapter_conversion_context.py: normalizes enabled/target_layers/train_scope (illegal scope with enabled raises immediately); anima_depth_expansion_runtime.py: performs interleaved duplication and zero projection at load; anima_full_finetune.py: on resume, validates that the checkpoint's layer count matches the config, with repair guidance on mismatch.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Parameters and VRAM rise proportionally with layer count; the expanded capacity needs enough data and steps to convert into quality gains.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The artifact is a full base model (large, not a LoRA); inference cost of the expanded model rises permanently; train_scope=all is the most expensive and new_layers is closest to the standard DUS recipe.
